## Activity

During July 2020, North City Eye Clinic completed 148 captures. This represents the recorded activity for the month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures below. The activity was reviewed as part of routine site operations reporting.

## Image quality

Of the 148 captures, 1 was ungradable. The ungradable rate was 0.7. This result should continue to be monitored through routine quality review. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that equipment-related problems can be identified and addressed promptly.

## Grading

Grading identified 37 referable results from the monthly activity. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This measure indicates the typical time between image capture and completion of grading during July 2020. The site should continue to review grading turnaround alongside image quality and referable findings, with any recurring operational issues recorded through the established service desk process.
